· Page 15 (unnumbered) the last paragraph is not clear.
Page 16 (unnumbered) on Adverse Effects is confusing. The first point which indicates that "cultural benefits" will be lost when the killing stops is highly questionable especially in the light of the proper exception for Eskimos and Indians. Point 3 is not an adverse effect, for with freedom also comes responsibility.
The next two pages are apparently written by another author who seems to have slight appreciation for the heightened consciousness that has developed for endangered species.
Page 19 (unnumbered) sentence 2 is not clear.
Pages 20, 21, 22, 23 and 24 appear to be penned by the same clear head who wrote the early portion of the statement.
Very sincerely,
Dennis Puleston
Chairman
Board of Trustees
DP: VP
cc: Mr. N. Reed
